text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship told me she wants to go shopping, so here we are in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I snagged some sesame-miso flavored space macarons.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I wanna try the sweet and savory fried chicken and the boiled egg flavors too, so they're on my list for next time.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's with all the hustle and bustle over there?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Did you hear that?! There's a raffle!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Speaking of, I got a piece of paper when I bought the macarons. Must be a raffle ticket.
choice_data_list: Want to give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Forget going big or going home. I'm aiming for the booby prize!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, so you guys got a booby prize for losers too? What is it? The carrot, or the stick? Or maybe even a wrecking ball!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Boldly aiming for the worst prize, Gold Ship turns the handle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the tumbler's opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I-I got the grand-prize?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Holy beneficial gut bacteria! That's like the polar opposite of the booby prize!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I really got the ticket for a hot spring vacation…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I was after the booby prize, but hey, this is awesome!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: A hot spring, huh? They're not fun to go to alone, though. Who should I—oh!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: If I just make a shadow clone of myself to go with, then all my problems will be solved! Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Time to try it out! Hiyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Shadow clooone! SPLIT!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wheeze… huff… puff… Well, that didn't work.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: How could I, Goddess Golshi the All-Capable, fail to make a simple shadow clone?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Dang… Welp, you hang onto the ticket for now. Here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Keep it someplace I can't see it until I master how to shadow clone.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah, otherwise I'll end up using it before I master the art!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not entirely sure Gold Ship ever will master shadow cloning, but I do as she asks and keep the ticket for her.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa! A deluxe carrot hamburger steak?! Lucky me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: We're having marbled steaks for dinner tonight, so this'll be perfect for desser―

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hold up a sec. This could be a golden opportunity to develop a brand-new space macaron flavor!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: First, I eat the deluxe carrot hamburger steak, yeah? Then, I write a review, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And then, I send it directly to the big shots at the space macaron factory.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: They love the idea, and next thing you know, they're releasing their brand new carrot hamburger steak flavor space macarons!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I can see it now! C'mon! We've got a foodie review to write!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to revolutionize space macarons, we start conducting research on carrot hamburger steaks.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's more of a mountain than a bushel. What should I do with all these?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah! Almost forgot. There's an intense training session for hopeful restaurant proprietresses coming up soon.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Slicing and dicing these carrots will be perfect practice!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'll master how to cut them into flowers, stars, and butterflies, then move onto shaping them like Gothic architecture…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That'll knock the socks off the current proprietress for sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After we get back to the dorm, I watch Gold Ship practice cutting the carrots into decorative shapes.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aw man! Third-prize? And it's just one carrot!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's neither the booby prize nor the grand-prize… I don't even know how to react. But!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I turned a piece of paper into a carrot. That's gotta be a miracle of some kind, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Thank you, paper! Thank you, carrot! It just goes to show that food is precious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We discuss just how grateful we are for the single carrot the whole way home.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The booby prize! That's what I'm talkin' ab—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hold up. A pack of tissues? That's it? So much for the carrot or the stick, then. Not even a little a wrecking ball…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: On a side note, do you know what happens when you make a paper airplane out of a tissue?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Some say it's shocking how poorly it flies, but others say it's so light that it never lands.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Let's go find out who's right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship pulls the booby prize just as she wanted, but unfortunately the item itself is not what she expected.
